concept.title: People affected by abuse or crime
concept.shortdesc: Survivors of domestic or sexual abuse and people in the criminal justice system, including offenders, prisoners and their families.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People of any gender and age who have experienced domestic abuse, sexual violence or stalking, and those concerned about them.
: Offenders, ex-offenders, prisoners and their families, along with some victims of serious crime.
